Congratulations, your heroes have found a {colour_start|notable}combat item{colour_end}! these special items may be activated directly from your inventory by {colour_start|notable}[RIGH-CLICKING]{colour_end} the item, make sure to pay attention to the item's targeting.

You have found a {colour_start|burn}Infernal{colour_end} item these items special items maybe traded within the {colour_start|burn}Infernal{colour_end} Merchant Network for special rewards, bewarned you always run the risk of losing something important to you...

In the setting of Spider's Court torches have been replaced with {colour_start|notable}lantern oil{colour_end}, these items come in three different qualities {colour_start|notable}Standard{colour_end}, {colour_start|notable}Good{colour_end} and {colour_start|notable}Industrial{colour_end} with different amounts given to the {colour_start|notable}Lantern{colour_end} they can be used either in the quest you are in now or saved for a future quest, but be forwarned these items are hard to find so be cautious when you decide to use them.
Take heed and read this tome first.
Iron said to repel what lurks in the dark, cold to the touch...
It failed to protect its owner, but perhaps...
Ancient books with secret esoteric information, sought after by some.
Stolen directly from the court's treasurey...
Tragic one needs money even in Hell these days. {colour_start|skill_unselectable}Some merchants value these coins,{colour_end}
Engine parts to repair our machines outlawed by the court...
Cold Iron: %d (Used to upgrade quarter facilities.)
Tomes of Knowledge: %d (Used to upgrade quarter facilities.)
BloodSucker Treasure: %d (Used to upgrade quarter facilities.)
Silver Coins: %d (Used for trading with the infernal and activaties.)
Engine Parts: %d (Used to create town quarters.)

When heroes {colour_start|notable}can't take the {colour_start|stressNOT1}stress{colour_end} any more{colour_end}, they can become {colour_start|harmful}AFFLICTED{colour_end}. This manifests in {colour_start|notable}different behaviors{colour_end} and {colour_start|notable}stat changes{colour_end}. {colour_start|harmful}Afflictions{colour_end} last until you {colour_start|notable}send them to treatment{colour_end} on the Flameseeker, unless you can reduce their {colour_start|stressNOT1}stress{colour_end} to zero during the quest.

Your hero is {colour_start|hexed}Hexed{colour_end}!
New statuses are applied in combat from both friends and foes, such as {colour_start|hexed}Hex{colour_end}, {colour_start|confused}Confusion{colour_end}, {colour_start|leeching}Leeching{colour_end}, {colour_start|frantic}Frantic{colour_end}, and {colour_start|enraged}Enraged{colour_end}. These new statuses are all identifiable by their effect on top of the character, with details shown by hovering over the special icon above the health bar.
Discretion is the better part of valor...
Merchants can be found in hallway and rooms, they can offer services and valuables in exchange for currency or specials in exhange.

Many actions and experiences cause {colour_start|harmful}{colour_start|stressNOT1}stress{colour_end}{colour_end}. {colour_start|harmful}{colour_start|stressNOT1}stress{colour_end}{colour_end} damage appears above heroes' heads, in black type. {colour_start|harmful}{colour_start|stressNOT1}stress{colour_end}{colour_end} can also be {colour_start|notable}healed{colour_end}, and that appears in white type.

There are several ways hereos may spend their time in Sanctuary Square as leave for a misson.
Heroes can relieve {colour_start|stressNOT1}stress{colour_end} by taking part in activities at the {colour_start|notable}Speakeasy{colour_end} or they can research and learn with {colour_start|notable}Tomes Of Knowledge{colour_end} in the {colour_start|notable}Research Center{colour_end}.
The {colour_start|notable}Library{colour_end}, {colour_start|notable}Field Research{colour_end} and {colour_start|notable}Laboratory{colour_end} in the {colour_start|notable}Research Center{colour_end} heal a very small amount of stress and {colour_start|notable}do not remove afflictions{colour_end} however they may gain tempory buffs and quirks that may be used for their next mission.
Committing a hero to an activity {colour_start|notable}locks them in that activity{colour_end} until the {colour_start|notable}next Week{colour_end}.

If you find yourself uncertain on aspects of Spider's Court, try using the Help Menu (using {colour_start|notable}[H]{colour_end} as a hotkey).
There are multiple Help Menus available in different places; The Sanctuary Square, each Quarter facility, the provision menu, dungeon rooms, dungeon hallways, and in the middle of combat.

When a hero is reduced to 0 HP, they are at {colour_start|harmful}Death's Door{colour_end}. Heroes start with 60%% of {colour_start|harmful}Deathblow{colour_end} Resist.
While on {colour_start|harmful}Death's Door{colour_end} a hero's maxmium resist is reduced by 10%% for each time they enter {colour_start|harmful}Death's Door{colour_end}, like wise passing a resist check will reduce a hero's {colour_start|harmful}Deathblow{colour_end} Resist by 3%%
Be wise when healing, as a turn wasted may lead too total destruction.
{colour_start|harmful}As a further word of caution death will have his quarry one way or another.{colour_end}

The {colour_start|notable}Lantern{colour_end} is fading!
In Spider's Court The {colour_start|notable}Torch{colour_end} has been replaced with The {colour_start|notable}Lantern{colour_end}, light burns out a much slower rate of 2 per tile, However {colour_start|notable}Lantern Oil{colour_end} is much harder to aquire.
As the light fades unique enemies that only spawn in the dark will start to emerge. {colour_start|harmful}Do not{colour_end} let the light reach zero as those that lurk in the dark will have the advantage over your heroes.
Lost souls surround screaming for you to run!
Serial killings have plagued the city. Another poor soul has been found, The Gang has allowed a tempory truce to let us investigate the crime scene. (No Battles)
{?hero_names}%s were unsuccessful in their search for the Ripper.
{?hero_names}%s Have investigated the area and found the Ripper's lair.
{?hero_names}%s turned into amuetur slueths and started thier investigation in the Ripper murders.
Don't expect battles in this mission search the surroundings for clues.
Each killing has become more brutal then the last, always a piece missing from the body.
The Gang has granted safe passage for now, in exchange for capturing the Ripper.
The Pirate Captain and his crew have have been found hiding in their hidden cove deep within the Bayou, strike now and take back was pilfered.
{?hero_names}%s were unsuccessful in their raid on the Pirate Captain's cove.
{?hero_names}%s returned with our possessions after dueling the Pirate Captain.
The Crew obeys their Captain and will not hesistate to defend him.
The Cannon needs another crew member to light his cannon, take the advantage before it is too late.
Do not take too long or else The Captain and his crew will vanish into the fog.
